name: DUACS AVISO Mesoscale Eddy Trajectory Atlas (META4.0 DT)
description: Global anticyclonic and cyclonic mesoscale eddy trajectories derived from multimission satellite altimetry, including location, contours, amplitude, radius, speed, and metadata; covers 1993 onward.
citation: The altimetric Mesoscale Eddy Trajectories Atlas (META4.0exp DT) was produced by SSALTO/DUACS and distributed by AVISO+ (https://aviso.altimetry.fr) with support from CNES, in collaboration with IMEDEA (DOI: 10.24400/527896/a01-2026.001 for the META4.0exp DT allsat version).

license.notes: AVISO+ product page states free of charge access for any purpose under its licence agreement; license identifier not specified here.
